children: Pump.fun has restored its iOS app to the App Store in the United States and India, making the launchpad accessible again on iPhone in both countries. The restoration reopens mobile access for users who previously could not download the app, returning a familiar entry point for creating and trading tokens on the go.

Mobile distribution is a practical channel for a launchpad, since token creation and trading depend on frequent, low-friction access. With the app listed again in two large markets, Pump.fun regains a retail on-ramp that had been unavailable to iPhone users there. Activity flowing through the app feeds the platform's fee generation, which is the mechanism through which renewed access relates to PUMP. Actual usage will depend on how many users return through the restored listing.
The pumpfun app is back on the iOS App Store in the United States and India!

title: Pump.fun: iOS App Returns to the App Store in the US and India - 18 Sep 2026
